```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root=root.parent
out=root/'assets/img/generated/interpolacio-comparada.svg'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':14,'svg.fonttype':'none'})

def elevation(x,y):return 100*x+60*y
def temperature(x,y):return 32-.006*elevation(x,y)+1.4*np.sin(x)*np.cos(y/1.5)
xy=np.array([[.5,.5],[2,.6],[4.7,.8],[1,2.6],[3,2.5],[5.5,2.8],[.7,4.3],[3.3,4.5],[5.3,4.4]])
observed=temperature(xy[:,0],xy[:,1]);alt=elevation(xy[:,0],xy[:,1])
xx,yy=np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0,6,151),np.linspace(0,5,126))
targets=np.column_stack([xx.ravel(),yy.ravel()])
dist=np.linalg.norm(xy[:,None,:]-targets[None,:,:],axis=2)
weights=1/np.maximum(dist,1e-12)**2;weights/=weights.sum(axis=0)
assert np.allclose(weights.sum(axis=0),1)
idw=(observed@weights).reshape(xx.shape)
b,a=np.polyfit(alt,observed,1)
trend=a+b*elevation(xx,yy);residual=observed-(a+b*alt)

# Ordinary kriging of residuals with a prescribed, valid spherical variogram.
# Distances are kilometres; semivariances are degrees Celsius squared.
def variogram(distance):
    q=np.minimum(distance/3.,1.)
    return np.where(distance<1e-12,0.,.05+.8*(1.5*q-.5*q**3))
n=len(xy)
pair_dist=np.linalg.norm(xy[:,None,:]-xy[None,:,:],axis=2)
system=np.ones((n+1,n+1));system[:n,:n]=variogram(pair_dist);system[-1,-1]=0
rhs=np.vstack([variogram(dist),np.ones(dist.shape[1])])
solution=np.linalg.solve(system,rhs);kw=solution[:n]
assert np.allclose(kw.sum(axis=0),1)
training_solution=np.linalg.solve(system,np.vstack([variogram(pair_dist),np.ones(n)]))[:n]
assert np.allclose(training_solution,np.eye(n),atol=1e-10)
combined=trend+(residual@kw).reshape(xx.shape)
truth=temperature(xx,yy)
surfaces=[truth,trend,idw,combined]
lo=min(s.min() for s in surfaces);hi=max(s.max() for s in surfaces)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(8,7.4),layout='constrained',sharex=True,sharey=True)
titles=['A · Camp sintètic conegut','B · Regressió amb altitud','C · IDW: distància, p = 2','D · Regressió + kriging residual']
for ax,surface,title in zip(axes.ravel(),surfaces,titles):
    image=ax.imshow(surface,origin='lower',extent=(0,6,0,5),cmap='YlOrRd',vmin=lo,vmax=hi)
    ax.scatter(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],color='#003366',edgecolor='white',lw=.8,s=28)
    ax.set(title=title,xticks=[0,2,4,6],yticks=[0,2,4])
for ax in axes[-1]:ax.set_xlabel('Est (km)')
for ax in axes[:,0]:ax.set_ylabel('Nord (km)')
bar=fig.colorbar(image,ax=axes,orientation='horizontal',shrink=.8,pad=.04,fraction=.06)
bar.set_label('Temperatura (°C) · escala comuna als quatre panells')
fig.savefig(out,facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
